home.headline: Good hair is a decision.
home.lead: Four barbers, eight services and a booking system that respects your time. Pick the cut, pick the chair, turn up.

list.title: What we do, what it costs.
list.note: No packages, no upsell. Services can be combined in one visit.

barbers.title: Four people who are good at this.
barbers.lead: Each has a subject. Book the one who does yours, or take whoever is free.

how.title: Three steps, then a chair.
how.step1Body: One service or several in a row. You see the total time and price before anything else.
how.step2Body: Choose a barber who does what you asked for, or let us give you the first one free.
how.step3Body: We hold the slot for {holdMinutes} minutes while you confirm. Change or cancel free of charge up to {cutoffHours} hours before.

visit.title: Find us off Calvert Yard.
visit.body: Ground floor, black front, no sign to speak of. Look for the window that is still lit at seven.

services.title: The whole list.
services.lead: Every price is the price. Durations are honest: a sixty-five minute appointment takes sixty-five minutes.
services.note1: Services can be combined in one appointment with the same barber.
services.note2: Not every barber does everything. The booking shows who does what you chose.
services.note3: You pay in the shop, after the cut. Prices are in US dollars.

barbers.title: Who holds the scissors.
barbers.lead: Four barbers, four subjects. The list under each name is what they do; the days are when they are in.

gallery.title: The shop, the tools, the work.
gallery.lead: Black walls, two chairs, one long counter. Nothing in the room that does not get used.

about.title: A small shop with a short list.
about.lead: CUT&CO is two chairs in East London and four barbers who share them. It does a few things and tries to do them properly.
about.story1: There is no walk-in queue and no waiting on a bench. Every chair is booked, every appointment has a length, and the next person does not sit down until yours is finished.
about.story2: The list of services is short on purpose. Each barber offers only the work they would be happy to be judged on, which is why you will not find every name next to every service.
about.story3: Booking is online because the phone is always engaged when you need it. Pick a time, confirm it from your email, and change your mind up to twelve hours before without explaining yourself.
about.principle1Body: Appointments start when they say they start. If we are running late, that is our problem, not yours.
about.principle2Body: If a cut will not suit your hair, you will hear it before the clippers come out.
about.principle3Body: Nobody will try to sell you a product at the till. The price on the list is the price.
about.conceptBody: CUT&CO does not exist. It is a concept built for a portfolio: the shop, the barbers, the address and the prices are invented, and the photographs were generated for the project. The booking system behind it is real software, built the way a working shop would need it.

contact.title: Where and when.
contact.lead: The quickest way to reach us is to book. For anything else, the details are below.
contact.findBody: Five minutes on foot from Shoreditch High Street station. Calvert Yard is a cobbled lane; the shop is the black front halfway down, on the left.
contact.bookBody: Booking takes about a minute and needs only a name, an email address and a phone number.
contact.fictionNote: The address, phone number and email belong to a fictional shop. Please do not try to use them.

booking.title: Book an appointment
booking.demoNotice: Preview of the booking flow. Times shown are examples; nothing is stored and no email is sent yet.

services.title: What are we doing?
services.lead: Choose one service or several. They are done one after another by the same barber.
services.noBarber: No single barber does all of these in one visit. Remove a service, or book them as separate appointments.
services.chooseOne: Choose at least one service to continue.

barber.title: Who is cutting?
barber.lead: These barbers do everything you chose.
barber.anyNote: We pick whoever is free at your time.

time.title: When?
time.lead: Appointments open {horizonDays} days ahead and at least two hours from now.
time.emptyHint: Try another date, or choose “Any available” to see every barber's times.
time.error: The times could not be loaded.
time.choose: Choose a start time to continue.

details.title: Who is it for?
details.lead: We send a link to this email to confirm the booking, and reminders the day before and two hours before.
details.name: Name
details.privacy: We use these details only for this booking. You do not need an account.

email.invalid: This email address looks incomplete, for example name@example.com.
email.tooLong: That email address is too long.

phone.invalid: Enter a phone number with 7 to 15 digits.
phone.tooLong: That phone number is too long.

details.fix: Check the marked fields to continue.

review.title: Check it over.
review.lead: Nothing is booked until you confirm from your email.
review.terms1: We hold this time for {holdMinutes} minutes while you confirm by email.
review.terms2: You can change or cancel free of charge up to {cutoffHours} hours before the appointment.
review.terms3: Payment is taken in the shop, in US dollars.
review.slotTaken: That time has just been taken. Choose another one — your details are kept.
review.failed: Something went wrong and nothing was booked. Please try again.
review.tooManyHolds: This email address already has bookings waiting to be confirmed. Confirm or let them lapse, then try again.
review.invalid: Something in this booking is no longer valid. Please start again.

held.title: Check your email.
held.body: We are holding your slot until {time}. Open the link we sent to {email} to confirm the booking.
held.demo: This is a preview: no email was sent and no slot was held.
held.noEmail: Nothing in your inbox after a minute? Look in the spam folder. The hold lapses by itself if it is not confirmed.

confirm.title: Confirm your booking
confirm.lead: Press the button to confirm. Until you do, the time is only held for you.
confirm.expiredBody: A slot is held for a short time only, and this one was not confirmed in time. Nothing was booked. Choose a time again and it will take a minute.
confirm.invalidBody: It may have been used up, mistyped or cut short by your mail program. Open the link from the most recent email, or book again.

manage.justConfirmed: Confirmed. A confirmation email is on its way.
manage.cancelledBody: The time has been released. You are welcome to book again whenever suits.
manage.closedBody: There is nothing left to change here. We hope to see you again.
manage.pendingTitle: This booking is not confirmed yet.
manage.pendingBody: Open the confirmation email we sent you and press the button in it.
manage.noSessionTitle: Open the link from your email.
manage.noSessionBody: To show a booking we need to know it is yours. Open the link in your confirmation or reminder email; for your security it keeps this page open for thirty minutes at a time.
manage.invalidLinkBody: It may be out of date or cut short by your mail program. Use the link from your most recent email.
manage.changeNote: You can move or cancel this booking free of charge up to {hours} hours before it starts.
manage.lockedNote: It is less than {hours} hours until this appointment, so it can no longer be changed online.
manage.rescheduleLead: Same services, same barber. Your current time stays yours until you confirm the new one.
manage.rescheduleChoose: Choose a new start time first.
manage.rescheduleDone: Moved. An email with the new time is on its way.
manage.cancelBody: The time will be released for someone else. This cannot be undone.

errors.past_cutoff: It is too close to the appointment to change it online.
errors.slot_taken: That time has just been taken. Please choose another.
errors.not_changeable: This booking can no longer be changed. Open the link from your email again if you think that is wrong.
errors.unavailable: Something went wrong and nothing was changed. Please try again.
